_comment: Lore terminals (scripts/lore_terminal.gd). Optional reading, never needed to finish a floor. Miro is canonically Prisoner M-07: guards and staff call him the prisoner. Only the records reveal that he is also a test subject (a Ward classification), never a name for him. Spoiler rules (memory: miro-story-canon): never say he is immune, never say the tower made the sickness, never name Niro or say 'brother' before Level 5's face-to-face reveal; Levels 1-2 must not say he was a Keeper (Level 3's personnel record reveals that). Hints are fine. 'position' is a standing point; the terminal snaps to the floor below and steps sideways until clear. Each page is one bubble: keep it under about 110 characters.

pages:
PRISONER M-07 · Cell 07
Name: withheld by order of the Ward.

Charge: pending review.
Sentence: indefinite.

Visitors: none.
Next of kin: one, on staff. File sealed.

Ward classification: TEST SUBJECT.
Keep this off the cell card. Keepers are not to know.

NIGHT LOG · CELL 07
Day 41: M-07 asked his own name. Told 'M-07'. He repeated it politely.
Day 44: Hums the same four notes when he thinks nobody is listening.
Day 52: Holds his meal tray like a baton, wrist turned in. Like he was trained.
Flag for Records. Do NOT discuss him with the Keepers on his corridor.

ROSTER · WEEK 9
Corridor C: two Keepers off sick. Covered by Corridor D (also coughing).
Reminder: a cough is not a reason to leave your post.
Do not speak to the prisoner in 07. If 07 asks about family, walk away.

CAMERA AUDIT
03:12 Feed 4 loops. Same corridor, same moth, forty seconds.
03:14 Unlogged transmission on the prisoner remote band. Source: inside the tower.
Action: none. The source has clearance above Security.
Note: the prisoner in 07 talks back to it. Let it run. Useful.

ACCESS REVOKED (excerpt)
One Keeper, rank removed, moved to the cells as a resident.
Uniform destroyed. Name struck from the rota and the gate list.
Reason: asked to see the lower ward. Such requests count as treason.
No further questions are to be logged.

SAMPLES · PRISONER M-07 (TEST SUBJECT)
Draws 29, 30, 31 complete.
Prisoner asked what they are for. Do not answer. Keep the labels out of sight.
Draw 32 delayed. Prisoner would not sleep.
In the margin, different handwriting: 'Let him keep the light on.'

MEMO · WARD BOARD
The trial continues. Indefinite sentences need no consent form.
Outcomes are for the Board only.
Staff who object will be reminded of the Board's generosity to their families.
And of where their families live.

Unsigned, left open on the desk.
He asked for the guitar again in his sleep.
I tuned it and put it on the stand. If he walks in, he'll know it's his before he knows why.
I keep telling myself the tower lets him go when this is finished.
I keep writing it down so it stays true.
